Convert KiCad boards (.kicad_pcb or .kicad_pro) and symbol libraries (.kicad_sym) to Signex native files

Usage: signex-kicad-import [OPTIONS] <INPUT>

Arguments:
  <INPUT>  A .kicad_pcb, a .kicad_pro whose folder holds the boards, or a .kicad_sym symbol library (written as one .snxsym)

Options:
  -o, --output <OUTPUT>  Output directory. Defaults to the input file's directory
      --force            Replace output files that already exist
      --json             Print a JSON summary on stdout instead of human-readable progress
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version
